description:
"Get a piece of the rock!"
Prudential Insurance commercial featuring a famous slogan and actor George Coe as "Mr. Finnegan." The barber appears to be actor Michael Vale (Dunkin' Donuts Man). Spot aired November 1974. *Visit https://www.bionicdisco.com for 1970s pop culture fun.*
